source: explicitly labelled capture replay; current-session active_observation(include_images=True)

camera_pool.frustum_boundary: Inclusive NDC [-1,1] on all axes; positive camera depth.
camera_pool.geometry_conversion: Source Fraction to nearest binary64 once, retaining full world geometry.

margin.square_fit: max absolute right/up projection about the one common center

camera_pool.pixel_center_convention: NDC maps to (size-1)/2 coordinates; raster samples integer pixel index +0.5.
camera_pool.raster_depth_ties: Strict nearer update; an equal-depth sample retains the earlier supplied surface.
camera_pool.scope: Whole-scene geometric raster cameras; no ROI IDs, visibility matrix or oracle input.

scope.domain: maximal edge-connected exact planar rectangular patches

patch_support.triangle_index_scope: zero-based source triangles within each object

location_conventions.visible_pixel_bounds: inclusive bounds of actual ROI-owned pixels
location_conventions.visible_pixel_anchor: ROI-owned pixel nearest bounds center; row-major ties
